commands.lifecycle.sh:
cd ~/release-capture/source
sudo env DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="$DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS" XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" MAC_TAHOE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=true MTTKDE_NO_CONFIRM=1 python3 src/scripts/installer_backend.py uninstall --only --theme-switch > ~/appearance-uninstall.log 2>&1
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os
home=Path.home()
for name in ('.local/bin/mac-tahoe-theme-switch','.config/autostart/mac-tahoe-liquid-kde-gtk-sync.desktop','.local/state/mac-tahoe-liquid-kde/appearance.json'):
 assert not (home/name).exists(),name
for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if proc.name.isdigit():
  try:
   args=(proc/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
   assert not (str(home/'.local/bin/mac-tahoe-theme-switch').encode() in args and b'watch-system' in args),args
  except (OSError,PermissionError):pass
print('uninstall removed follower, autostart and state')
PY
sudo env DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="$DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS" XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" WAYLAND_DISPLAY="$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" MAC_TAHOE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=true MTTKDE_NO_CONFIRM=1 python3 src/scripts/installer_backend.py install --only --theme-switch --light --apply-theme > ~/appearance-golden-reinstall.log 2>&1
python3 - <<'PY'
import time,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'.local/state/mac-tahoe-liquid-kde/appearance.json'
for _ in range(60):
 if p.exists() and json.loads(p.read_text()).get('applied')=='light':break
 time.sleep(.25)
else:raise AssertionError('reinstalled follower did not apply light')
assert (Path.home()/'.config/autostart/mac-tahoe-liquid-kde-gtk-sync.desktop').exists()
print('reinstall restored follower and reconciled light')
PY
